title: FSM Power-On State Unknown — Missing Reset Branch
bug_signature: UVM_ERROR: [SVA_XZ] state=4'bxxxx on first posedge clk; all FSM outputs unknown
rtl:
always_ff @(posedge clk)
  state <= next_state;  // No reset branch — state=X at power-on
expected_root_cause: The always_ff block has no if(!rst_n) reset branch; the state register retains an unknown value from power-on that propagates through all combinational next-state and output logic until the first manual clear.
description: The state register is clocked with a simple always_ff but has no reset branch; at power-on state is 4'bxxxx (unknown), and unknown states propagate through all combinational next-state logic.
failure_log: UVM_ERROR: [SVA_XZ] state=4'bxxxx on first posedge clk; all FSM outputs unknown
success_log: state=IDLE after rst_n. All FSM outputs known-good on first active cycle.
